backup_not_configured: Backups need a public key first.
backup_not_found: There is no backup of your keys on this instance yet.
backup_private_key_offered: This is the PRIVATE key. Only the public one goes on the instance: that is what keeps it from reading its own backups.
backup_public_key_invalid: The backup public key must start with “age1”.
backup_settings_from_environment: These backups are set by environment variables: change them in the container's configuration file.
bio_troppo_lunga: The description cannot be longer than {{max}} characters.
cannot_message_self: You cannot open a conversation with yourself.
casa_che_ordina_non_raggiungibile: The home that manages the group is not answering: you cannot add or remove members.
chiave_di_questa_istanza: This is this instance's own key: an instance does not link to itself.
chiave_mancante: The other instance's public key is needed.
commento_non_inviato: The comment did not arrive: that home did not answer, or cannot receive it yet.
conflict: Someone else changed the group at the same moment. Refresh and try again.
cuore_non_arrivato: The like did not arrive: that home did not answer, or cannot receive it yet.
data_not_durable_anonymous: This instance's data is on an anonymous volume, which is lost every time the container is recreated by anything other than `docker compose` — such as the NAS panel. Mount a folder or a named volume on the data directory, then try again: you will only have to do the setup once.
data_not_durable_ephemeral: This instance's data is inside the container and will disappear at the first update. Mount a folder or a named volume on the data directory, then try again: you will only have to do the setup once.
device_not_approved: This device cannot decide for the others: it has to be authorised first.
device_not_registered: This device has no key yet: sign out and sign back in over a secure connection.
empty_comment: The comment is empty: write something.
empty_post: The post is empty: write something or add an image.
follow_inesistente: You are not following this person.
follower_inesistente: This person does not follow you, and has not asked to.
forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
instance_already_configured: This instance has already been set up: sign in with your account.
instance_not_configured: The instance is not set up yet.
internal_error: Something went wrong on the instance. Try again: if it keeps happening, tell whoever administers it.
invalid_credentials: Username or password is not valid.
invalid_cursor: I can't load the rest: reload the page and try again.
invalid_image: This file is not a readable image.
invalid_instance_name: The instance name cannot be empty.
invalid_invite: This invite is not valid: it may have expired, been used up or been withdrawn.
invalid_recovery_code: Username or recovery code is not valid.
invalid_request: This request is not valid: reload the page and try again.
invalid_setup_token: This code is not valid. It is the one printed in the instance's console, and it changes at every restart.
invite_no_longer_valid: The invite behind this request is no longer valid: it expired, was used up or was withdrawn. To let this person in, send them a new invite.
istanza_bloccata: This instance is blocked. Unblock it before linking.
istanza_non_raggiungibile: This person's home is not answering. Try again later.
join_request_already_decided: This request has already been answered.
media_already_used: This image is already used in a post.
media_missing: The image is no longer available.
media_quota_exceeded: You have used up your space for images. Delete some old posts.
media_too_large: The image is larger than allowed.
media_too_many_pixels: The image has too many pixels to be processed.
nessuna_richiesta: There is no link request from this instance.
network_probe_from_environment: The network probe is set by ESTIA_NETWORK_PROBE: changing it from here would only last until the next restart, so it cannot be changed from here.
no_device_available: This person has no device ready for messages yet: that happens as soon as they open ESTIA.
nome_troppo_lungo: The display name cannot be longer than {{max}} characters.
nome_vuoto: The display name cannot be empty.
not_found: What you are looking for is not there, or not yet.
rate_limited: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.
rete_non_attiva: This needs another home, but this instance is not on the network. Whoever administers it can switch the network on from EstiaNet.
rete_non_disponibile: This instance does not talk to the others yet.
rete_spenta: The network between instances is off on this instance: switch it on from the panel or with ESTIA_NETWORK_PROBE.
richiesta_incompleta: Both who to follow and on which instance are needed.
unauthenticated: You are not signed in, or your session has expired. Sign in again.
unsupported_media_type: I accept JPEG, PNG or WebP images.
username_taken: This username is already taken. Choose another one.
